The '''800 barrel''' was a model of [[Spread barrel/Legends|spread barrel]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and sold for 1725 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Only compatible with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] or [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], the attachment was available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
